body.statement: If only \(\delta\in\mathcal D\) is scientifically justified, then \(\Theta_I^{\mathcal D}(b,q,\omega)\) is the sharp closed identified set over \(\bigcup_{\delta\in\mathcal D}\mathfrak M_\delta(b,q,\omega)\). A uniform below-unity conclusion holds exactly when \(\sup_{\delta\in\mathcal D}\max_{x\in\mathcal P_\delta(b,q,\omega)}c_\omega^{\top}x<0\); a uniform above-unity conclusion is obtained by the symmetric minimum criterion. Reports give the pointwise sets and sign certificates over \(\delta\in\mathcal D\) together with this envelope; absent controlled validation, \(\mathcal D=[0,1]\).
body.justification: The sensitivity parameter is scientifically interpretable only through a prespecified range, so identification and sign reporting must aggregate the same pointwise compatible-law analyses.
body.gap: Existing vaccine challenge-effect bounds do not provide a sharp envelope over a bounded noninfecting-exposure priming fraction.
body.consumer: Trial analysts can display exactly which ratio and sign conclusions survive the scientifically defensible priming range, including the unrestricted range when no validation substudy exists.
